rootCauseHypothesis.evidence: Attempt18 candidate2 matched both integrated capture poses, support-relative invariants, selector checks and replay completion, while only tap correction bounds failed; drift reached 74.02px/311.16px and angular drift 1.709/4.154rad.
rootCauseHypothesis.changeHypothesis: The restored baseline lacks the pending-pose machinery because Attempt18 candidate2 was rolled back. First reconstruct only the previously observed exact capture, selector, lifecycle and one-shot release contract from Attempt18 candidate2 evidence; then test the new deterministic post-capture kinematic envelope: project the airborne player center no farther than 8px and angle no farther than 0.4rad from the immutable captured pose until tap consumption, without recapture, support following, or changes to normal no-pending flight.
rootCauseHypothesis.envelopeRule: after each fixed-step integration while pending, project player center to <=8px and angle to <=0.4rad from the immutable captured pose; preserve normal airborne state and do not recapture or follow the support
rootCauseHypothesis.stageRule: apply only after the capture step and before contact/failure evaluation; leave capture coordinates and support-relative reconstruction unchanged
rootCauseHypothesis.falsifier: if exact captures change, either tap exceeds <=10px or <=0.5rad, replay misses 11.9s/x>2000, or preserved lifecycle/contact selectors regress, reject the kinematic envelope
